Priya L: Quick sync: we need to decide the boundary between coalescing and enrichment for observability. Two axis: where dedupe happens (edge vs ingest) and when billing tags are assigned (pre- or post-enrich). Thoughts?
Noah M: My bias: emit a stable `billing_key` as early as possible. If gateway can compute it deterministically we avoid downstream ambiguity.
Omar C: Agree on stable key, but gateway computing it means any change to the key algorithm requires fleet rollout. That can break historical attribution unless we version the key.
Rina T: Versioning idea: include `billing_key_v` header with value `v1` and have consumers accept multiple versions. Older keys stay queryable for cost reports.
Priya L: Also: if gateway compresses/joins ids, we must preserve sampled-span mapping. We can't lose which original request triggered trace sampling.
Noah M: Suggest `X-Billing-Key: <hash>` and `X-Orig-Ids: <maybe single id or short fingerprint>`; for large batches push a compact proto to kafka with schema v1.
Omar C: Proto path requires enrichers to be able to parse that proto early in the pipeline and attach billing tags before cost aggregation. That's a contract change for the pipeline.
Rina T: Pipeline contract change checklist: 1) proto schema published; 2) enrichment services updated to parse proto; 3) fallback path if proto missing: accept single-header id; 4) metrics to verify tag propagation.
Priya L: Cardinality concern: if gateway emits high-cardinality billing_tag values we will blow up cost-aggregation tables. We need a rollout knob to cap unique keys per tenant-route or to normalize keys to buckets.
Noah M: Could hash the key down to N bits per tenant, configurable. We should emit both raw_key (for internal debugging) and hashed_key (for billing) but only hash used in aggregation. Raw_key stored in trace context for investigation.
Omar C: Hot-shard risk: centralized coalescer will concentrate traffic for popular routes. If we put coalesce in ingest we need shard-selection strategy that respects tenant affinity to avoid single-node overload.
Rina T: For sharding maybe use `billing_shard = murmur(billing_key) % num_shards` and map to ingestion partitions. Also expose `coalesce_size` metric per shard so we can autoscale.
Priya L: Observability taxonomy we should add: `coalesce.variant` (edge|ingest|central), `billing.key_version`, `billing.hashed_key`, `coalesce.size`, `coalesce.window_ms`. Add to schema repo with examples.
Noah M: Sampling invariants: if child requests are sampled at gateway, the coalesced span needs a canonical sampled flag. We must decide if we preserve per-child sampling or pick a canonical child.
Omar C: Practically we pick canonical sampling based on strongest sample (if any child sampled -> sampled) and record `coalesce.sampled_children = N`. That keeps queryability.
Rina T: Migration: support dual-path enrichment for 3 months: accept header-only and proto-only. Run parity checks that compare billing counts from both paths nightly.
Priya L: Failure semantics: if coalesced request partially fails, how to report? Options: 1) fail all and return shared error; 2) attempt per-child responses. 1 is simpler for runtime. 2 gives better UX for clients that can multiplex responses.
Noah M: Leaning to fail-all default with opt-in per-route `allow_partial_responses=true`. Document in API spec.
Omar C: Security: proto must be authenticated and size-limited. Edge could sign proto blob with ephemeral key to prevent tampering in transit.
Rina T: Metrics and dashboards: add an `obs/coalesce/efficiency` dashboard showing tokens_saved, coalesce_rate, average_coalesce_size, fallback_rate. Useful for Optimize product.
Priya L: Ownership: gateway-team owns proto v1 shape and signing; ingest-team owns parser and shard mapping; billing-team owns aggregation using hashed_key; observability owns dashboards.
ingest-bot: deploy-bot: ingest-service build 9a1c3 queued (tests green) :rocket:
billing-bot: billing-pipeline: nightly reconciliation job scheduled
Noah M: Next steps: I will PR proto schema; Omar will draft shard mapping; Rina will add metrics defs; Priya will write migration checklist. Deadline next Tues.
Priya L: Thanks, all. Adding to eng-platform agenda and will open a short RFC addendum.
